No trees, tall bushes, vehicles, buildings, roads, text, grid, border, vignette, camera angle or painted broad scene shadows. Tileable on all four edges with evenly distributed composition, no central hero feature. Scattered creeping dark olive groundcover plants 10-25cm across and only 5-12cm high, tiny dense leaves; varied density. Distinct small bare patches surrounded by darker grass. Fine rounded and fractured 3-12cm pebbles partly embedded, a few weathered 20cm stones. Make the earthy dark recesses visible from an RTS distance; preserve muted sunny highlights on dry grass.

assets.name: olive
assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / precise material colour calibration. EDIT TARGET: the supplied square ground texture. Preserve its EXACT layout, all grass mat outlines, every stone/leaf/soil feature, all scales, resolution, texture structure, crop and existing tiny upper-right contact-shadow directions. Make ONE change: calibrate its BASE COLOUR reflectance for a bright physically lit game so the game will not wash it out. Reduce the average LINEAR RGB reflectance to about 55% of the supplied image (roughly 20-25% darker in display RGB), maintaining local contrast and detailed highlights. Shift the grass slightly away from golden yellow toward muted earthy olive; keep dry straw tawny and exposed earth a deep neutral warm brown. Dark roots and crevices must remain dark. Stones should be weathered neutral grey, with readable fine detail, not white. The resulting texture should visibly look darker and more subdued than the reference. This is a calibrated diffuse/albedo material, not a bright photograph. Do NOT add new objects, rearrange anything, blur, sharpen into noise, rotate/mirror, change the light direction, add a vignette/global gradient, increase cast shadows or paint new shadows. Every physical feature must stay registered with the existing height/normal map. Square seamless repeating extent unchanged. No labels, borders or text.
